newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan scraps three bids for RBD palm oil.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan scraps three bids for RBD palm oil.

text.p: The state-run Trading Corp of Pakistan (TCP) scrapped its tender for 9,000 tonnes of RBD palm, discarding the three bids it had received, dealers said on Wednesday.
The TCP gave no reason for the decision, taken on Tuesday, but was likely to re-tender later, one dealer said.

Pan Century had offered a rate of $505.40 per tonne Free On Board (FOB) and Felda $508 per tonne FOB for 9,000 tonnes of palm oil in the first half of November. Cargill offered $511.88 for 3,000 tonnes of palm oil for shipment by November 20.
